Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the eligibility of foreign medical school graduates for licensing as physician assistants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the eligibility of foreign medical schoolgraduates for licensing as physician assistants; and amending RCW18.71A.045.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.71A.045 and 1994 sp.s. c 9 s 322 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Foreign medical school graduates shall not be eligible forlicensing as physician assistants after July 1, 1989.)) Graduates offoreign medical schools shall comply with the licensing requirementsset out in this chapter and by the commission in order to be licensedas physician assistants.
